svg.aria-label: A grid of 100 squares split between 5 parts: Adult Social Care 0, Housing Services (GFRA only) 12, Cultural and Related Services 29, Environmental and Regulatory Services 32, Central Services 27. Adult Social Care is under half a square and not drawn.
